card.line: Lydda was a city near Joppa, on the road toward Jerusalem, where Peter healed a paralyzed man and many people turned to the Lord.

moments.title: Peter heals Aeneas
moments.text: Peter visited the saints in Lydda and found Aeneas, who had been paralyzed and in bed for eight years. Peter said Jesus Christ heals him, and Aeneas got up right away.

moments.title: Lydda turns to the Lord
moments.text: All who lived in Lydda and Sharon saw Aeneas, and they turned to the Lord.
